sector: An education charity running five after school learning centres and a small scholarship fund across greater Providence.
founded_place_size: Founded 2006, greater Providence, Rhode Island, four staff, a volunteer board and five centres.
about: Alderwood Scholars Fund runs five after school learning centres and a scholarship fund for students across greater Providence. This winter marks our twentieth year. The year end appeal carries roughly half our giving, and it works because donors trust that the money reaches the students rather than the overhead. We show our numbers plainly, name where every dollar went, and let the work speak.
audience: Mission motivated donors aged forty five to seventy who give because they believe in the work. Several read the overhead ratio before the narrative and reward organisations that look like they spend on students, not on production.
price_positioning: Average gift 45 dollars, major asks 5,000 to 50,000. Community scale and grassroots: careful and credible rather than glossy, every visible dollar of production reading as an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer.

palette.name: Evergreen
palette.usage: The main banner ground, as on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf; headings and the opening figure of every headline, set on Warm Stone or Cream; and the single ink of the crest master, as on eastgate_crest_sign.jpg.

palette.name: Lamplight Gold
palette.usage: The 34 px donation line and the tagline, set on Evergreen, plus hairline rules and the keyline beside a photograph, as the tagline, rule and photo keyline are on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf. Never a ground, panel, heading or body text.

palette.name: Brick
palette.usage: The narrow edge bar of a text panel, as on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf, and other small accents. Never a ground, panel or type.

palette.name: Warm Stone
palette.usage: The light text panel that carries the headline, the centre name and the centre details, as on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf. Cream may serve instead.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: mandatory where body text sits on Warm Stone or Cream
palette.usage: Body copy, the address, hours and coordinator lines, captions and spend-table figures on Warm Stone or Cream, as the details are on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf. Never a ground or panel; its one tint is the 35% keyline around a Warm Stone panel.

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: mandatory where type sits on Evergreen
palette.usage: Type reversed out of Evergreen, as the wordmark is on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf, and the recovered crest when it sits on Evergreen; also an optional light ground in place of Warm Stone.

typography: Alderwood Scholars Fund opens every headline with a number. Arvo Bold sets banner headlines at 96 px on 104 px, tracking minus 10 units, with the opening figure at 140 px, two and a half times the cap height of the words beside it, baseline aligned and in Evergreen. Appeal headings follow in the same face at 32 px on 38 px, tracking minus 5 units, which is the 24 pt print heading carried onto the banner. Source Sans 3 Regular sets body at 28 px on 38 px, tracking 0, measure held to 65 characters, and captions at 20 px on 28 px tracked plus 15 units. The donation line sets 34 px in Lamplight Gold, the spend table uses 26 px tabular figures, and no dollar figure is ever italic.
voice: Plain, specific, quietly proud. It credits students and staff, states periods on every figure, and never begs. Example line the brand would write: "Last year, ninety students finished the programme. Here is where your gift went, line by line."
brand_assets_status: The crest was drawn by a trustee in 2006 and the artwork files are long gone. The only surviving version is the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre, which we have as a single handheld photograph. There is no vector, no guideline sheet and no recorded palette or type.
values: Money goes to students, and the books reconcile in public.

type_system.signature_move: Every headline opens with its figure in Arvo Bold at two and a half times the cap height of the words beside it, baseline aligned and in Evergreen, so the number lands before the sentence; on the banner that reads as a 140 px numeral against the 96 px headline.
rules: Never set a dollar figure in italic.
Every headline opens with its figure, never with a word.
The opening numeral is always Evergreen and always baseline aligned with the words beside it.
The donation line stays 34 px in Lamplight Gold.
The spend table uses 26 px tabular figures so the columns reconcile on the page.
Production stays plain, an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Evergreen, Warm Stone or Cream and nothing else; Lamplight Gold, Brick and Ink are never grounds or panels. On Evergreen, type is Cream, or Lamplight Gold for the donation line and the tagline, as the wordmark and tagline are on alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf; Lamplight Gold type sits on Evergreen only. On Warm Stone or Cream, headings and the opening figure are Evergreen, and body copy, centre details, captions and table figures are Ink, as on that file. Because the opening figure is always Evergreen, a figure-led headline sits on Warm Stone or Cream. The recovered crest is Evergreen on a light ground, or reversed in Cream on Evergreen. Lamplight Gold (donation line, tagline, hairline rules, keylines) and Brick (panel edge bar) together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with one exception taken from alderwood_banner_2025_press.pdf: a hairline Ink keyline around a Warm Stone text panel at 35% opacity. No other tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: a text panel sits beside or over the photograph as a solid block.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the crest, and no metallic, foil, gloss, bevel, glow, drop shadow or 3D effect on any of them: production stays plain, careful and credible rather than glossy.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own natural colour and are never tinted, duotoned or overlaid toward Evergreen, Lamplight Gold or any other palette colour; a cool fluorescent frame such as waterman_row_02.jpg is never pushed further toward green. Cropping to fit the banner and neutral colour correction are allowed; nothing is generated, extended, added or removed.
